$comment: Python service sharing the same Jira project as the frontend, with tests written for every feature and a dangerous test suite. Illustrative ids.

project.name: API Service
project.stackSummary: Python 3.12, Flask 3, Flask-SocketIO (gevent), SQLAlchemy 2 + PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery + RabbitMQ, pytest, ruff

commands.testSingleFile: docker compose exec -T -e ENVIRONMENT=testing web pytest <file> -q

testing.notes: ALWAYS pass ENVIRONMENT=testing or the fixture drop_all()s the dev database. Run one file per command, never the full suite, never several paths. Ask before the first run of a session.
